announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l2 — headless automation
announcements.summary: Adds the headless daemon handoff for quota refresh, token renewal, Mailbox renewal, and quota countdown automation.
announcements.content:
This local release makes Manager automation continue without an active VS Code connection.
1. Headless daemon: keep token renewal, Mailbox renewal, and quota refresh running while VS Code is closed.
2. Quota ownership: delegate automatic foreground refresh through the loopback Control API and retry shared-lease contention instead of misreporting a whole batch as failed.
3. Countdown: synchronize the Dashboard setting to the daemon so an eligible reset window can send one short conversation and start the official countdown.
4. Safety: preserve the existing extension identity, private-state permissions, proxy selection, and cross-host lease protection.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l2 — 后台自动化
zh.summary: 新增无需 VS Code 连接即可持续运行的 daemon，接管额度刷新、token 和 Mailbox 续期以及倒计时自动化。
zh.content:
本地版本让 Manager 自动化在没有活动 VS Code 连接时继续工作。
1. Headless daemon：VS Code 关闭后继续执行 token 续期、Mailbox 续期和额度刷新。
2. 额度归属：前台自动刷新通过 loopback Control API 委托给 daemon，共享 lease 冲突改为可重试状态，不再把整批账号误报为失败。
3. 倒计时：Dashboard 设置同步到 daemon，额度窗口符合条件时发送一次短对话并启动官方倒计时。
4. 安全性：保留既有扩展 ID、私有状态权限、代理选择和跨宿主 lease 保护。
